content:
The image shows a single leaf with:
- Irregular, pale grayish-white patches scattered across the upper leaf surface
- Patches appear powdery or dusty in texture, not sunken or necrotic
- Leaf remains largely intact without tip dieback or margin lesions
- No dark sooty coating, no lesion rings typical of anthracnose, no shoot dieback

The powdery, whitish-gray blotchy coating distributed across the leaf surface is classic Powdery Mildew.
